subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack assistant-thread native status show active tool-level labels, and if so should that behavior be default, safe/coarse-only, or opt-in after the Slack-safe visibility policy is settled?
rationale: Current source makes the wiring feasible, but the visible Slack status semantics overlap fixed loading messages, status reactions, draft progress, custom status requests, and the open safe-visibility issue.

options.title: Defer Behind Safe Visibility
options.body: Keep this issue open and implement per-tool native status only after maintainers choose the Slack-safe disclosure/default policy that also constrains https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92085.

options.title: Ship Coarse Labels Now
options.body: Allow only broad safe labels such as running/searching/reading in native status, keep raw tool details out, and document how it coexists with loading messages and progress drafts.

options.title: Decline Native Tool Status
options.body: Treat fixed `loading_messages`, status reactions, and progress drafts as the supported Slack progress surfaces and close this request after a maintainer states that product direction.

recommendation.title: Defer Behind Safe Visibility
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and implement per-tool native status only after maintainers choose the Slack-safe disclosure/default policy that also constrains https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92085.

likelyOwner.reason: He recently merged and authored adjacent Slack native-status/status-message decisions and is the clearest history-backed owner for choosing the visible Slack behavior.
